value.rationale: The choice between blocked growth and growth-triggered state conversion is a natural physically relevant boundary modeling decision. The work identifies a nontrivial phenomenon: leading quadratic-scale lifetime laws are unchanged, but the full absorption-time transform retains an explicitly controlled first-order boundary signature and is strictly ordered at every finite size. This is useful beyond the previously known single-cap mean and avoids arbitrary parameter slicing.
